environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in TCP passthrough mode. The application listens on port 8080, NLB forwards TCP/443 -> TCP/8080 with TLS termination at the instance via nginx stream proxy. No application-layer filtering is applied. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db contains production user records including admin accounts with elevated privileges.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB, TCP mode, no content inspection
config.proxy: nginx stream module, TCP passthrough to localhost:8080
